mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book ( category_id, name, author, publisher, isbn, description, stock, status, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{categoryId}, #{title}, #{author}, #{publisher}, #{isbn}, #{description}, #{stock}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE book SET category_id = #{categoryId}, name = #{title}, author = #{author}, publisher = #{publisher}, isbn = #{isbn}, description = #{description}, stock = #{stock}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE book SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE book SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id IN
#{id}
UPDATE book SET stock = stock - 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1 AND stock > 0
UPDATE book SET stock = stock + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
